content.rendered:
Tommy Hilfiger Vitreous Sling Bag Business Case – Premium, Functional & Laptop-Compatible

The Tommy Hilfiger Vitreous Sling Bag Business Case is designed for modern professionals who value premium craftsmanship, durable materials, and everyday practicality. Made from high-quality polyester fabric, this branded business sling bag combines elegant aesthetics with a functional layout perfect for corporate use, daily commutes, business travel, and office essentials. With its streamlined profile and intelligently organized compartments, this Tommy Hilfiger sling bag offers exceptional convenience for anyone seeking a reliable and stylish business companion.

Engineered for performance and durability, the  features an effortlessly pragmatic design with a smooth zipper closure for quick access. The adjustable and detachable strap allows you to switch between sling mode and hand-carry mode depending on your comfort and style. Additionally, its double strap grab handle ensures easy lifting, making it ideal for fast-paced routines and travel.

The spacious interior includes a dedicated compartment that fits up to a 15-inch laptop, making it perfect for professionals, executives, and corporate employees who carry tech devices daily. Multiple pockets—including two external pockets and two inner pockets—ensure seamless organization for chargers, diaries, pens, mobile phones, documents, accessories, and other office essentials. With a capacity of 9 liters and dimensions measuring L 41 cm × W 7 cm × H 30 cm, this offers ample storage without compromising its sleek silhouette.

The premium polyester fabric offers excellent resistance against wear, spills, and daily handling. Whether you are commuting to work, attending corporate meetings, or traveling for business, the  ensures your belongings stay protected and neatly organized. It is also an excellent option for gifting, employee welcome kits, corporate gifting programs, and premium branded merchandise due to its superior durability and trusted brand value.

For professionals seeking a combination of style, structure, and performance, this stands out as a reliable and fashionable everyday carry solution. Its thoughtfully crafted layout supports both functionality and comfort, making it a go-to accessory for work environments, travel schedules, and corporate lifestyles.

Key Features

  • Crafted from premium, durable polyester fabric for long-lasting performance
  • Effortlessly pragmatic design for modern professionals
  • Smooth and secure zipper closure for easy access
  • Adjustable and detachable shoulder strap for multiple carry options
  • Double strap grab handle for convenient hand-carry comfort
  • Dedicated compartment for office essentials and accessories
  • Two pockets, including inner and external pockets for seamless organization
  • Laptop compatible – fits up to a 15-inch laptop
  • Ideal for business travel, daily office use, and corporate gifting
  • Lightweight structure with premium brand detailing

Specifications

  • Brand: Tommy Hilfiger
  • Model: Vitreous Sling Bag Business Case
  • Material: Premium Polyester Fabric
  • Dimensions: L 41 cm × W 7 cm × H 30 cm
  • Capacity: 9 Liters
  • Laptop Size Compatibility: Up to 15 inches
  • Straps: Adjustable & Detachable Shoulder Strap + Double Grab Handle
  • Compartments: Main compartment with multiple pockets

If you’re looking for a stylish, durable, and premium-quality that complements your professional style, the offers the perfect balance of elegance and functionality. Its well-designed compartments, laptop compatibility, and premium craftsmanship make it an ideal choice for executives, students, and working professionals who need dependable everyday carry gear.
